answer.reason: The correct value is 226,731 covered jobs. This is consistent with QCEW-scale benchmarks: nationally, NAICS 54 (professional, scientific, and technical services) accounts for roughly 11.5 million covered jobs, and Arizona's roughly 2% share of national covered private employment (about 2.7 million covered private jobs statewide, with an industry location quotient slightly below 1) implies a statewide NAICS 54 level in the low-to-mid 200,000s. A December figure of ~227,000 fits this expectation (December employment in this industry is typically near or slightly below the annual average), whereas 177,356 would imply an implausibly low share for Arizona's professional services sector. This matches the supplied draft answer B.
